[
  {
    \"id\": \"book-pragmatic-programmer\",
    \"title\": \"The Pragmatic Programmer\",
    \"author\": \"Andrew Hunt, David Thomas\",
    \"notes\": \"Great reminders about feedback loops and ownership.\",
    \"status\": \"reading\",
    \"createdAt\": \"2026-08-27T00:00:00.000Z\",
    \"finishedAt\": null
  },
  {
    \"id\": \"book-clean-code\",
    \"title\": \"Clean Code\",

/bin/bash -lc "set -e
sleep 0.3
curl -sS -i http://localhost:3000/ | head -n 20
printf '\\n----\\n'
curl -sS -i http://localhost:3000/books/book-pragmatic-programmer | head -n 20
printf '\\n----\\n'
curl -sS -i -X POST http://localhost:3000/books -d 'title=Deep+Work&author=Cal+Newport&notes=Focus+book' | head -n 20
printf '\\n----\\n'
new_id="'$(node -e "import('"'./lib/books-store.js').then(async m=>{const b=await m.listBooks(); console.log(b.find(x=>x.title==='Deep Work').id);})\")
curl -sS -i -X POST \"http://localhost:3000/books/"'${new_id}/finish" -d '"'returnTo=/' | head -n 20
printf '\\n----\\n'
node -e \"import('./lib/books-store.js').then(async m=>{const b=await m.listBooks(); const book=b.find(x=>x.id==='"'${new_id}'"'); console.log(JSON.stringify({id:book.id,status:book.status,finishedAt:book.finishedAt"'!=null},null,2));})"'

/bin/bash -lc "set -e
curl -sS -i http://localhost:3000/books/book-pragmatic-programmer | head -n 20
printf '\\n----\\n'
